evidence: The ALD WN xCy deposition was carried out in an ASM Pulsar®2000 reactor integrated with an automated wafer handling platform. This was achieved with a repetitive ABC A ¯-type pulse sequence of surface reactions, where individual A, B, and C stand for the precursors triethylborane /H20851/H20849C2H5/H208503B/H20852, tungsten hexafluoride /H20849WF6/H20850, and ammonia /H20849NH3/H20850, respectively. WF6 and NH3 gases were mixed with nitrogen gas and introduced in the deposition chamber. Liquid /H20849C2H5/H208503B was evaporated and introduced in the chamber by flowing N2.
